description: This file is a shell script used for testing the backend of a Git repository implementation, specifically involving ref management, ref locking, reflog expiration, and related operations. It contains setup routines, test cases, and assertions to verify correct behavior of Git's ref handling mechanisms.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, with a description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path does not exist.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_readlink
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link.

methods.name: test_has_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running a test.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
